gaps.description: Lack of typed knowledge graph tables (graph_nodes, graph_edges, graph_evidence, entity_aliases) preventing multi-hop relational retrieval.
gaps.remediation: Create SQLite migration adding graph tables and indexes with foreign keys.

gaps.description: Lexical BM25 ranking lacks principled rank fusion (RRF), resulting in false-positive matches on token overlap and false-negatives on technical concepts.
gaps.remediation: Implement Reciprocal Rank Fusion combiner fusing FTS5 lexical, graph neighborhood, and context alignment scores.

gaps.description: FTS5 query syntax crashes when task contains unescaped boolean operators or punctuation (*, ", AND, OR, NOT).
gaps.remediation: Implement robust FTS5 query sanitizer with token normalization.

gaps.description: Absence of query caching causing repeated recommendation queries to re-evaluate 851 candidates at 31-42ms latency.
gaps.remediation: Implement content-hashed LRU query cache with automatic invalidation on registry updates.

gaps.description: Single recommendation mode cannot adapt between quick lookup and deep multi-hop dependency resolution.
gaps.remediation: Implement multi-mode retrieval: fast, balanced, deep, discovery, bootstrap.

gaps.description: No graph traversal capability to discover prerequisites, complements, and conflicts across skills.
gaps.remediation: Implement recursive SQLite CTE graph traverser with max-depth and relationship filtering.

gaps.description: Project boundary not strictly enforced, risking traversal outside project root into parent directories.
gaps.remediation: Enforce strict root resolution and boundary checks with Path.resolve().is_relative_to().

gaps.description: Test suite detection ignores test configuration files (pytest.ini, conftest.py, playwright.config.ts).
gaps.remediation: Add inspection patterns for test framework configs and test directory structures.

gaps.description: MCP server lacks transparency tools for scoring breakdown, graph exploration, and health statistics.
gaps.remediation: Add explain_recommendation, graph_query, graph_neighbors, list_project_profiles, and skillforge_health tools.

gaps.description: CLI does not provide commands for graph inspection, cache management, or automated evaluation.
Dashboard has only 5 basic pages and lacks interactive graph visualization, retrieval sandbox, and evaluation dashboard.
gaps.remediation: Transform dashboard into a 10-view developer intelligence console with HTML5 canvas graph visualizer.

gaps.description: Missing database PRAGMA tuning for cache_size, temp_store, and synchronous mode.
gaps.remediation: Configure optimal SQLite pragmas (WAL, NORMAL sync, MEMORY temp_store, 64MB cache).
